observations: A white multi-function printer (MFP) wrapped in clear plastic film.
HP logo is visible on a piece of paper taped to the front of the unit in photo 0.
The text 'HP Color LaserJet Pro MFP' is partially legible on the taped paper in photo 0.
The printer has a flatbed scanner on top and a paper input tray at the base.
The control panel screen is visible but appears to be powered off.
The specific model number is obscured by the plastic wrap and the taped paper.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model name/number on the front of the printer.
Photo of the 'Usage Page' showing the total page count.
Photo of the 'Supplies Status' page showing toner and drum life.
A photo of a test print or demo page produced by this specific machine.
Photo of the printer with the plastic wrap removed to check for casing damage.
response.reason: The exact model number is unreadable, which is the primary driver of price for this class of electronics. Additionally, the seller's claims about low usage and new consumables cannot be verified without internal status reports.
